name: Ink Wash
summary: Xieyi ink painting on rice paper, animated: mostly empty paper, ink only in five tones, loaded brushstrokes that break into flying white, mountains dissolving into mist, titles in vertical columns and one small vermilion seal.
suits: a film built on one line

palette.use: rice paper: the empty space that is most of every frame; also water, mist and sky
ink at full density (warm black): every stroke and every word, at one of five tones
ink at its lowest density (cool grey): the far end of the ink ramp, never a separate paint
vermilion: the seal, and at most one tiny story accent; never a wash, never type

type.case: small caps for titles in vertical columns; sentence-case italic inscriptions
type.emphasis: placement in empty paper, and the seal

motion.exit: dissolves into mist, or an ink bloom

banned: watercolour: no colour washes, no hue but ink and one vermilion
vector art with a brush texture: no flat fills, no closed outlines, no Western contour lines
a red wash or red type: vermilion is the seal and at most one tiny accent
generic dissolves or wipes: things are painted, bloom, or dissolve into mist
parallel semi-transparent strokes for bodies (organ pipes) or uniform hatching (wire mesh)
dry brush that looks like dashed lines
a busy frame: if it's busy, remove ink rather than add tone
copying a specific painting, film composition or calligraphy
